### God's Is the Victory - Truth for Life - June 28
Author: Truth for Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-june-28.html
Passage: Exodus 7:12
Points:
- Aaron's staff consuming the magicians' staffs demonstrates that God's work inevitably overcomes all opposition and demonic counterfeits.
- Saving grace redirects a person's heart away from worldly desires toward heavenly priorities.
- Christ's work on the cross decisively conquers the overwhelming guilt and power of past sins.
- Faith in Jesus provides believers with the strength to overcome worldly trials, temptations, and doubts.
- Genuine devotion requires that love for Christ serves as the supreme, consuming passion of one's life.
